metadata.scenario: A woman calls for the first time asking about post-surgery rehabilitation services for her husband who had a knee replacement last week. She wants to know what types of therapy are available and how quickly they can start. The receptionist explains the intake process. Caller is optimistic. First-time caller.

transcription.text: Thank you for calling CareFirst Home Health, this is Margaret. How can I assist you today? Hi Margaret, I’m calling for the first time. My husband just had a knee replacement last week, and I’m looking for post-surgery rehabilitation services. Of course! We offer several rehabilitation options. Can you tell me a bit more about what you’re looking for? Well, I want to know what types of therapy you provide and how quickly we can get started. Absolutely! We provide Physical Therapy and Occupational Therapy, focusing on mobility and daily living skills. We can usually start within a few days of the request. That sounds great! What does physical therapy involve? Our Physical Therapy sessions typically last 45 to 60 minutes. They include exercises to improve strength, balance, and mobility after surgery. And how much do those sessions cost? The cost for Physical Therapy is between $110 and $140 per session. We also accept various insurance plans if that’s a consideration for you. Oh, that’s good to know. We do have insurance. What’s the next step? First, we’ll need to complete an intake process. I can assist with that. We’ll gather some basic information about your husband and his needs. Sounds good! Is it a long process? Not at all! It usually takes about 10 to 15 minutes over the phone. After that, we can schedule his sessions. Wonderful! What information do you need from me? I’ll need your husband’s full name, date of birth, and any specific concerns you have regarding his rehabilitation. Sure! His name is Mark Thompson, and his date of birth is June 15, 1955. Thank you! And any specific issues we should address in his therapy? Mostly just pain management and regaining his mobility. He’s been eager to get moving again. That’s understandable. We’ll make sure to focus on that during his sessions. Thank you! How soon could we get someone scheduled? We could potentially start as early as this week, depending on therapist availability. That would be perfect! I really appreciate your help, Margaret. You’re very welcome! I’ll take care of the intake details, and we’ll follow up with you shortly. Great! Please keep me updated. Absolutely! I’ll also check for any potential insurance authorizations needed. Perfect, thank you again! Thank you for calling, and we look forward to helping Mark recover!
